hebrewText: שָׂרֶ֣י/הָ בְ/קִרְבָּ֔/הּ כִּ/זְאֵבִ֖ים טֹ֣רְפֵי טָ֑רֶף לִ/שְׁפָּךְ דָּם֙ לְ/אַבֵּ֣ד נְפָשׁ֔וֹת לְמַ֖עַן בְּצֹ֥עַ בָּֽצַע

tokens.bdb: a head person (of any rank or class)
tokens.kjv: captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord,(-task-)master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.

tokens.bdb: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] among, [idiom] before, bowels, [idiom] unto charge, [phrase] eat (up), [idiom] heart, [idiom] him, [idiom] in, inward ([idiom] -ly, part, -s, thought), midst, [phrase] out of, purtenance, [idiom] therein, [idiom] through, [idiom] within self.

tokens.bdb: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels)
tokens.kjv: catch, [idiom] without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, [idiom] surely, tear (in pieces).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food
tokens.enLiteralWord: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food
tokens.explanation: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food
tokens.explanationEn: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food

tokens.bdb: something torn, i.e. a fragment, e.g. a fresh leaf, prey, food
to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
tokens.kjv: cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.

tokens.bdb: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: blood  of man or an animal; by analogy
tokens.enLiteralWord: blood  of man or an animal; by analogy
tokens.explanation: blood  of man or an animal; by analogy
tokens.explanationEn: blood  of man or an animal; by analogy

tokens.bdb: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
tokens.kjv: break, destroy(-uction), [phrase] not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, [idiom] and surely, take, be undone, [idiom] utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.
tokens.explanation: nefesh — alma, ser vivo, vida, pessoa, desejo interior

tokens.bdb: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
tokens.kjv: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), [phrase] lest, that, to.
(be) covet(-ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to (covetousness), greedy, perform, be wounded.
